title: Tissue Collection Protocol
author: Gabriel J. J. Barrero
materials: Put a test strip in the glucose meter.
Inject blood into the serum separation tube.
Likewise, excise the right median liver lobe.

steps.title: Prepare Animals and Labeling
steps.instruction: Prepare the rats and the necessary tracking labels for tissue collection.

substeps.instruction: Fast animals overnight (~14:00:00 to 16:00:00), providing water.
Scan RFIDs of rats to be processed and enter them into the yellow area of the barcodes-text-ratGWAS.xlsx worksheet.
Print 30 identical barcoded labels per rat using the 'Barcodes for printing' worksheet and 'Printing Cryo Babies.docx' instructions (print each sheet 6 times).
Label freezer boxes (2”, 3”, or 5” high) with Center (MI, TN, NY), tissue type, box number, and date (e.g., TN-Batch 08 Feb-17).

steps.title: Set Up Collection Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the physical and digital environment for sample collection.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a bucket of dry ice containing a glass beaker filled with isopentane for flash-freezing.
Create a data entry file using the template RatSampleCollection_BatchNN_MI_DDMonYYYY_Template_v3 (e.g., RatSampleCollection_Batch02_MI_04Jun2015.xlsx).
Prepare a glucose meter (Contour NEXT) by inserting a test strip and verifying the reading with control solution against the range on the strip box.

steps.title: Collect Glucose and Weight
steps.instruction: Obtain baseline physiological measurements from the rat.

substeps.instruction: Restrain the rat and cut ~1mm from the tip of the tail.
Milk the tail from base to tip, discard the first drop of blood, and place a subsequent drop on the glucose strip; record the reading.
If glucose is collected at a different time than sacrifice, record data in columns A-H of the spreadsheet and enter 'NA' in other cells.
Record the rat's weight in grams with 0.1 g precision.

steps.title: Extract Fecal Pellets
steps.instruction: Collect fecal pellets rapidly to preserve microbiota integrity.

substeps.instruction: Secure the rat on the researcher's arm and externally massage the rectal canal (1-2cm from anus) to check for pellets (small solid masses ~1cm).
Gently push the pellet toward the anus and immediately collect it into a sterile tube.
Snap freeze pellets on dry ice and store at -80 °C.
If no pellets are present, repeat the attempt after a few minutes; if still absent, proceed to anesthesia.
Set oxygen flow to ~1L/minute.
Place the rat in an induction chamber with oxygen and isoflurane lines; set isoflurane to ~5%.
Wait until the rat is lying down with eyes slightly shut.
Remove the cover and pinch the toes to confirm a surgical plane of anesthesia; if the rat reacts, return it to the chamber.

steps.title: Measure Body Length
steps.instruction: Record the physical dimensions of the rat.

substeps.instruction: Tape a ruler to the table to prevent movement.
Measure the length from the tip of the nose to the end of the butt (0.1cm precision).
Measure the length from the tip of the nose to the end of the tail (0.1cm precision).

steps.title: Perform Initial Incision and Blood Collection
steps.instruction: Expose the cavity and collect blood samples.

substeps.instruction: Place the rat on its back and apply the isoflurane nose cone.
Make a 'Y' incision in the skin above the abdominal cavity using forceps and scissors; remove extra skin to expose the peritoneal cavity.
Cut through the diaphragm using scissors while holding the sternum with forceps.
Insert a needle from a 5 mL syringe into the heart tip and collect ~5ml of blood.
Cap the blood tube, invert 5 times, and place on ice.
Place a serum separation tube (SST) with a funnel on wet ice; decapitate the animal using a guillotine over the funnel to collect all trunk blood.
Recap the tube, invert 5 times, and keep on ice.
Cut off the head and record the start time of dissection (if a second person is not available, do this after the liver is frozen).
Open the skull, remove the whole brain, and submerge it in isopentane cooled by dry ice (~ -30 °C).
Once completely frozen (~30 seconds), wrap in aluminum foil, transfer to a ½ oz jar, and keep on dry ice.

steps.title: Collect Liver and Peritoneal Fat
steps.instruction: Harvest the liver and fat pads from the abdominal cavity.

substeps.instruction: Extract the top left liver lobe (left median lobe), avoiding large veins/arteries.
Tare a labeled ½ oz jar, weigh the liver lobe (to 1mg), record weight, cap, and place on dry ice.
Locate the left kidney, remove attached fat, and clear the cavity of fat moving toward the testicles (using the faint line of fat as a landmark).
Locate the right kidney and remove the right side peritoneal fat.
Combine both left and right peritoneal fat in one labeled ½ oz jar, weigh (to 1mg), record weight, cap, and place on dry ice.
Locate the epididymis (curved area above the testicle) and cut the fat away with scissors.
Repeat for the second testicle and combine both epididymis fat pieces in a labeled ½ oz jar.
Weigh (to 1mg), record weight, cap, and place on dry ice.
Locate ovaries on uterine horns; cut parametrial fat away from the kidney and trim it away from the uterine horn, ensuring the ovary is cut around.
Combine both left and right parametrial fat in a labeled storage container, weigh (to 1mg), record weight, and store.

steps.title: Collect Heart and Kidneys
steps.instruction: Harvest the heart and kidneys, using formalin for the right kidney.

substeps.instruction: Cut the heart by cutting the aorta; blot with gauze to remove excess blood.
Tare a labeled ½ oz jar, weigh the heart (to 1mg), record weight, cap, and place on dry ice.
Dissect the left kidney by cutting the renal artery, vein, and urethra; remove extra fat.
Tare a labeled ½ oz jar, weigh the kidney in grams, record weight, cap, and place on dry ice.
Dissect the right kidney; place it into a pre-filled labeled container with 10% (v/v) ZBF Zinc formalin.
Cap the container, weigh it, and record the weight in grams.

steps.title: Collect Cecum
steps.instruction: Rapidly isolate the cecum to preserve contents.

substeps.instruction: Locate the cecum (dead end where small and large intestines meet).
Cut immediately at the entrance of the small intestine and below the exit to the large intestine.
Place the isolated cecum and contents into a sterile 50 ml tube.
Place on dry ice and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Dissect Soleus Muscle
steps.instruction: Isolate the soleus muscle from the leg.

substeps.instruction: Cut a circle around the ankle (skin only) and pull the skin up toward the knee.
Poke a hole between the Achilles tendon and connecting tissue; remove the outer covering of the gastrocnemius by pulling along the white line.
Identify the brighter red soleus muscle below the gastrocnemius.
Use thin-tipped forceps to pull the soleus forward; place a hemostat on the tendon near the Achilles tendon.
Cut the tendon to release the muscle, pull the hemostat to reveal the knee connection, and cut the knee-end tendon.
Place the soleus in a labeled ½ oz jar and place on dry ice (do not weigh).

steps.title: Collect Spleen, RFID, and Penis
steps.instruction: Harvest remaining small tissues and the identification tag.

substeps.instruction: Remove the spleen and place it into a 2 ml tube containing 0.5 ml saline.
Locate the RFID tag and place it in the same ½ oz jar as the spleen; place on dry ice.
Push the abdomen on either side of the penis until it emerges; grab with forceps, pull, and cut at the base.
Place the penis in a labeled 2 mL tube and freeze.
Make incisions at the lateral and medial canthi of the right eye.
Insert curved Dumont #5 forceps under the eye (avoid puncturing) and gently pull to stretch extraocular muscles.
If the right eye dissection fails, repeat for the left eye and note in the file.
Place the eye in a labeled 7 mL vial containing 1 mL of Karnovsky’s fix and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect Femur and Carcass
steps.instruction: Harvest the leg and dispose of the remaining carcass.

substeps.instruction: Place the rat in the prone position; retract the left leg and cut through skin/muscle as close to the body as possible.
Locate the femur and move scissors toward the hip joint; cut through the joint capsule to release the head of the femur.
Cut through the front thigh skin and soft tissues to remove the entire leg.
Place the leg in a barcoded 50 mL tube, place on dry ice, and transfer to -80 °C.
Remove the digestive tract, remaining internal organs, the remainder of the tail (excluding the 3/4 inch collected earlier), and the remainder of the head.
Place the carcass in a Ziploc bag with a barcode label inside and outside; freeze at -20 °C.

steps.title: Process Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge blood within 1 hour of collection.

substeps.instruction: Place the serum separation tube (SST) into a 50 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge at 4 °C at 3,000 rpm for 18 minutes (or adjust speed/time based on centrifuge).
Verify that the beige plug has separated the serum from red blood cells; spin again if necessary.
Transfer serum to microcentrifuge tubes in labeled boxes and freeze at -80 °C.
